text: dsh-malko-prefs 是面向 Web 版 DSH 的偏好设置插件，通过设置页和替换 agent preset 中的 compaction 引擎来扩展会话体验。它可调整上下文压缩阈值、保留量、摘要模型与推理级别，提供回合结束压缩和 /force-compact 命令；还能从 llama.cpp 服务导入模型元数据，并为等待、运行和完成状态更新标签页图标、发送浏览器通知及播放提示音。适合希望细调上下文管理、模型目录和会话提醒的 DSH 用户。需要 DSH 及配置了 baseURL 的模型 provider 才能使用模型导入；其余设置从插件页调整。

dsh-malko-prefs adds configurable DSH context compaction: tune thresholds, retention, summary model and reasoning, or force a compact. Import model metadata from a provider endpoint and track session status with tab colors, browser notifications and optional sounds.
想给 DSH 的上下文压缩阈值和保留量加上可调设置。
能不能让摘要使用指定的模型和推理级别？
我想在 agent 忙着运行时也能排队强制压缩上下文。
希望每轮会话结束时自动再做一次压缩。
怎么把 llama.cpp 服务发现的模型信息导入 DSH？
想在标签页里看到会话正在运行、等待我还是已经完成。
I want to tune when DSH compacts context and how much recent history it keeps.
Can I get browser alerts when a session finishes or needs my attention?
dsh-malko-prefs 的功能「可调上下文压缩」：设置页允许调整触发阈值、保留量、自动压缩和摘要模型；压缩引擎每次操作读取最新偏好。
dsh-malko-prefs 的功能「强制压缩」：调用 /force-compact 可立即压缩；agent 正忙时会排队，并在后续模型步骤触发。
dsh-malko-prefs 的功能「导入 llama.cpp 模型」：在模型设置中请求 provider 的 /models，预览上下文窗口、输出上限和输入模态后选择导入。
dsh-malko-prefs 的功能「会话状态提醒」：客户端根据会话状态为标签页图标着色，并可为完成或等待事件发送通知和播放所选提示音。
dsh-malko-prefs 使用模型导入时会向所选 provider 的 baseURL 请求 /models；若 provider 配有 apiKeyEnv，会解析凭据并以 Bearer 认证发送。

dsh-malko-prefs README · dsh-malko-prefs：> **Vibe coded.** This plugin was written almost entirely by an AI assistant
> (OpenCode, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`) from natural-language prompts, with light
> human review and testing. It is not a carefully hand-engineered product:
> read the code before trusting it, expect rough edges, and check what it
> changes in your dsh profile — in particular it **overrides your agent presets
> with a retargeted copy of the installed ones** (see [Install](#install)). Use
> at your own risk.

dsh-malko-prefs README · dsh-malko-prefs：Personal preferences for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a **tunable companion to the
official compaction engine**, a **llama.cpp model enrichment** for the Models
page, and **tab notifications**, packaged as a single dsh bundle.

dsh-malko-prefs README · dsh-malko-prefs：- **Compaction** — the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` engine is
  the reference behaviour; this plugin wraps it with a settings page so the
  threshold, the retention, the summarization model/reasoning and an optional
  end-of-turn compaction become user-configurable. It also adds a
  `/force-compact` command.
- **Model enrichment** — reads the richer model metadata a llama.cpp server
  exposes (`meta.n_ctx`, `architecture.input_modalities`, `aliases`) and fills
  the corresponding `llm-pi-ai` model entries (context window, text/image input).
- **Notifications** — the browser tab icon turns amber while a question/approval
  waits for you, blue while a session works, and green when a session finishes
  unattended; the browser raises a notification on either event with an optional
  sound. Ported from
  [`dsh-notice-center`](https://github.com/SCP-QQ/dsh-notice-center) (MIT).

dsh-malko-prefs README · Requirements：- **dsh ≥ `0.1.7-rc.1`** — built on the current settings domain (`Config`
  fields marked `.volatile()` on the Host, `ctx.configForms` on the Client) and
  on `BasicCompactionEngine`. Tested on `0.1.7-rc.2` and `0.2.0-rc.2`.
- A working `llm-pi-ai` provider (e.g. your llama.cpp server) for the model
  enrichment.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Install：From the registry (once published):

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-malko-prefs

dsh-malko-prefs README · then restart dsh web：```

Or from a local checkout / tarball:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-malko-prefs
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-malko-prefs-0.1.0.tgz
```

The bundle layer does two things (see `cordis.patch.yml`):

1. inserts the Host half: the settings service `malkoPrefs` and theyaml
- id: preset-standard
  name: 'dsh-malko-prefs/preset'
  config: !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl)('dsh-malko-prefs/preset-config')('standard', baseUrl, ctx)
```

dsh-malko-prefs README · then restart dsh web：`dsh-malko-prefs/preset` is a small wrapper around the upstream
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`: the upstream row is an `EntryGroup`, so the
Loader deliberately skips interpolation of its `config`; the wrapper is an
ordinary plugin, so the computed config is evaluated and then registered with
the same `agentPresets.register()` call.

dsh-malko-prefs README · then restart dsh web：`src/preset-config.cjs` locates
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/<id>.patch.yml` in the running dsh, parses it
with the Loader's YAML dialect (so `!!js` nodes survive), evaluates those nodes
against the Loader context (they drive `disabled` rows and `customSkillDirs`),
and swaps `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` for
`dsh-malko-prefs/compaction`. The plugin therefore follows the installed dsh
version instead of requiring a regeneration after every upgrade.
dsh-malko-prefs README · then restart dsh web：Rollback: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-malko-prefs` (then restart).

dsh-malko-prefs README · Compatibility：One release supports every dsh that ships
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/{cordis,minimal,ptc,standard}.patch.yml`
(currently `0.1.7-rc.1` and later). Because the preset bodies are read from the
running dsh, a dsh upgrade changes them without a plugin release; `engines.dsh`
declares the lower bound. There is no separate “old dsh” package line.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Settings — “Malko's prefs”：Adds a section to Settings, split into three sub-tabs: **Context compaction**,
**Notifications** and **llama.cpp models** (the tab bar stays pinned while the
panel scrolls). All fields are applied **live**
(no restart).

dsh-malko-prefs README · Compaction threshold：| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Threshold (tokens) | Absolute pressure in tokens, e.g. `130k` / `130K` / `1.5m`. Empty/0 = use the ratio below. |
| Context window (tokens) | Window the absolute threshold is expressed against (e.g. `200k`). 0 = ratio only. |
| Threshold ratio | Used when the absolute threshold is empty (0.8 = 80% of the window). |
| Headroom (tokens) | Reserved on top of the output cap. The official default (65536) caps the trigger well below 80%. |

dsh-malko-prefs README · Compaction threshold：Effective trigger: `min(window × ratio, window − output − headroom)`; when an
absolute threshold and a context window are set, it becomes exactly that
threshold. **Default: ratio 0.8 + headroom 32768 → compacts around 160k on a
200k window.**

dsh-malko-prefs README · Retention：`Keep last (tokens)` (absolute, e.g. `32k`) or `Keep ratio` — the verbatim
recent-context budget.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Behaviour：- **Automatic compaction** — the official between-step pressure compaction and
  context-overflow recovery.
- **Compact at end of turn** — runs one more compaction when the agent goes
  idle.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Summarization：- **Model** — `Session model` (default) or `Custom model`.
- **Provider / Model** — shown when `Custom model`; populated from the
  `llm-pi-ai` catalog.
- **Reasoning** — `Default`, `Off`, or any level the selected model declares
  (session mode exposes only `Default` / `Off`). The instruction is appended
  **after** the replayed prefix, so the provider's prompt cache stays warm.
dsh-malko-prefs README · Advanced：`Summary output cap`, `Extra compaction attempts`, `Overflow recovery attempts`.

dsh-malko-prefs README · llama.cpp models：For every `llm-pi-ai` provider that declares a `baseURL`, **Fetch from server**
reads `GET {baseURL}/models`. It then shows a **review of every discovered
model** and what importing would change: context window (from
`meta.n_ctx`/`n_ctx_train`), output cap, and input modalities (from
`architecture.input_modalities`); models that do not exist yet are marked *new
model*. Tick the models you want (or use **Select all**) and click **Import** —
only the selected ones
are written (existing entries are updated, new ones appended). The request
authenticates as the provider does: the endpoint's `apiKeyEnv` credential is
resolved (dsh credentials, then the host environment) and sent as
`Authorization: Bearer …`, so an api-key-protected server works.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：Two independent features, both driven by the official client signals
(`sessions`, `uiSession.sessionStatus`); nothing is persisted beyond the config.

**Tab status light** — recolours the browser tab icon:

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：| Colour | Meaning | Clears when |
|---|---|---|
| amber | a session waits for you (question / approval / plan review) | you handle it |
| working | a session is generating | it stops running |
| green | a main session finished while you were away | you open that session / return to the tab |
| idle | nothing to report (official favicon unless you set a colour) | — |

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：Priority is amber > working > green > idle, and sub-agent sessions are ignored.
All icon links are repainted together (DSH ships a dark and a light favicon
selected by `prefers-color-scheme`).

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：**System notifications** — settings are grouped by notification type. One
global master switch (**Enable notifications**, opt-in; the browser asks for
permission once), one global **Notify in the foreground** (off = only fire when
the tab is not visible and focused) and one global **Volume**. Then one group
per type — **When a session finishes** and **While waiting for you** (question /
approval / plan review) — each with its own **Notify** enable, **Keep on screen**
(stay until dismissed) and sound.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：**Sound** (per type) — each group's selector defaults to **No sound** (both
defaults are silent on a fresh install). The list is: `No sound`, two built-in
synthesized chimes (`Chime Up` / `Chime Down`, no asset needed) and 45 bundled
opencode sounds (see [`assets/audio/README.md`](assets/audio/README.md)); picking
one previews it and the Host serves the mp3s at `/malko-prefs-sounds/<id>.mp3`.
If that route is unavailable the player falls back to a chime — but browsers may
block audio until you have interacted with the page at least once.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：The sound is **decoupled from the banner**: once a sound is chosen for a type it
plays on that event (completion / waiting) even when notifications — or that
type — are disabled; with **No sound** nothing plays.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：| Field | Key | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Color the tab icon | `colorsEnabled` | on |
| Finished / Waiting / Working / Idle color | `green` / `amber` / `working` / `black` | official sidebar colors for green/amber, blue for working; `black` empty = official favicon |
| Enable notifications (master) | `notifyEnabled` | **off** |
| Notify in the foreground (global) | `notifyForeground` | off |
| Volume (global) | `notifyVolume` | `0.6` |
| Finished: notify / keep on screen / sound | `notifyDoneEnabled` / `notifyDonePersistent` / `notifyDoneSound` | on / off / `none` |
| Waiting: notify / keep on screen / sound | `notifyPendingEnabled` / `notifyPendingPersistent` / `notifyPendingSound` | on / off / `none` |

dsh-malko-prefs README · Notifications：> System notifications need a **secure context** — `http://127.0.0.1:PORT` or
> `localhost`. Opened over a LAN IP the Notification API is unavailable (a
> browser rule, not a plugin one); the tab status light still works.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Commands：- `/compact` — the official dsh command (idle manual compaction).
- `/force-compact` — compact **now**: immediately when the agent is idle,
  otherwise queued and consumed at the next model step (bypasses the threshold).

dsh-malko-prefs README · How it works：```
host plugin  (lib/index.mjs)
  ├─ Config (volatile)  ──▶ settings page "malko-prefs"
  ├─ service malkoPrefs ──▶ live prefs + force queue
  ├─ service malkoModels ──▶ llama.cpp probe (wire def in lib/typert.host.mjs)

The engine reuses the official engine for everything else (durable
transactions, pruning, overflow recovery), so behaviour matches
`compaction-basic` unless a preference changes it.

dsh-malko-prefs README · How it works：Note: service classes avoid JS private members (`#x`) — cordis binds service
methods to a proxy, and private members would throw
`Receiver must be an instance of class ...`.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Development：```
node build.mjs            # esbuild → lib/{index,compaction,typert.host}.mjs + lib/client.js
node scripts/check.mjs    # static conformance checks
```

dsh-malko-prefs README · Development：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/prefs.ts` | preference fields, defaults, `parseTokenText` |
| `src/index.ts` | host plugin: volatile Config, `malkoPrefs`, `/force-compact` |
| `src/compaction.ts` | `MalkoCompactionEngine` (extends the official engine) |
| `src/remote.ts` | shared wire identity + `probeInvocation()` builder |
| `src/typert.ts` | Host Typert manifest (zod strict codecs) |
| `src/typert.host.ts` | the `./typert` export entry `dsh-typert-loader` imports |
| `src/probe.ts` | `malkoModels` Service (llama.cpp `/models` probe) |
| `src/client.ts` | settings page (three sub-tabs) |
| `src/notify.ts` | tab status light + notifications + sound player (ported from dsh-notice-center) |
| `assets/audio/` | 45 bundled notification sounds (opencode, MIT) |
| `src/whale.ts` | the recolored official whale SVG used as the tab icon |
| `src/preset.ts` | ordinary-plugin wrapper that registers a computed preset with `agentPresets` |
| `src/preset-config.cjs` | builds each agent preset from the installed dsh presets and swaps the compaction engine |
| `scripts/check.mjs` | manifest / bundle / preset / cache-safety checks |

dsh-malko-prefs README · Publishing：- `private` is removed; `LICENSE` (MIT) and `author` are set; `files` ships
  `lib/`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `scripts/`, `assets/` and `LICENSE`.
- `prepublishOnly` runs the build and `scripts/check.mjs`.
- Conformant bundle: `dsh.bundle.patch`, `exports["./client"]` and
  `exports["./package.json"]`, the client bundle id equals the package name,
  and the client requires only baseline platform modules (`react`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`).
- The name is free on npmjs.com; release with `npm publish` (unscoped/public).

dsh-malko-prefs README · Publishing：Caveat: `engines.dsh` declares the supported dsh range. The preset bodies are
read from the installed dsh at load time, so the plugin follows preset content
changes automatically; only a new preset **id** requires adding a row to
`cordis.patch.yml` and `src/preset-config.cjs`.

dsh-malko-prefs README · Limits：- The preset retarget reads `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`
  through the dsh install and uses `js-yaml`; a future dsh that moves or
  reformats those files will fail loudly at preset mount instead of silently
  mounting a stale copy.
- The `/force-compact` busy path uses the engine's context-overflow entry,
  which compacts the maximal safe head (retention 0).
- The model enrichment is host-side (the browser cannot reach a local
  llama.cpp server cross-origin).
- Browser notifications require a secure context (`127.0.0.1`/`localhost`); the
  tab status light's green/amber state is in-memory and resets on reload.
- Notification sound is best-effort: browsers may block audio until the page has
  had a user gesture, and if the `/malko-prefs-sounds` route is unavailable the
  player falls back to a synthesized chime.
